about_short_description.short_description: YouGotListings is an online rental technology platform providing tools for real estate offices and landlords.

product.name: Premium Syndication
product.description: A service that syndicates apartment rental listings to major real estate websites, both free and paid, from a single platform.

product.name: Ad Posting Automation
product.description: Automates the posting of rental ads to websites that require manual entry, including Craigslist and Facebook Marketplace.

product.name: Managed Marketing
product.description: A service providing fully managed marketing and advertising support to increase listing exposure and control costs.

product.name: Open Listings Network
product.description: A network that allows sharing and accessing apartment rental listings among local brokers and landlords at no cost.

product.name: Market Intelligence
product.description: Analytics and reporting tools that measure marketing performance and provide competitive pricing insights for rental listings.

product.name: Rentals Software
product.description: A comprehensive software suite including rental inventory management, CRM, data entry services, and API access for real estate marketing operations.
